七上 · 人教版 · 课时A计划
**Starter Unit 3　Welcome!**
**第三课时**　Section** **B** **(1a-1e)

[IMG image1.jpeg]
Ⅰ.根据首字母及汉语提示补全单词
1.What <u>e　　　　</u>(别的) can I do for you? 
2.Walk along the river,and you can see a <u>f　　　　</u>(农场) on your left. 
3.We need to <u>c　　　　</u>(圈出) the key words when doing some reading. 
4.Linda and her sister like to take a walk by the <u>l　　　　</u>(湖) in the park. 
5.Our school has a <u>b　　　　</u>(大的) library with many books. 
Ⅱ.根据汉语意思完成句子,每空一词
1.你在那家书店里可以看到许多种书。
You can see<u>　　　　</u> <u>　　　　　　　　</u>books in that bookshop. 
2.我可以看一下你的新书包吗?
Can I <u>　　　　　　　　</u>your new schoolbag? 
3.这张老照片是黑白的。
This old picture is <u>　　　　　　　　　　　　</u>. 
4.你的新眼镜是什么颜色?
<u>　　　　</u> <u>　　　　　　　　</u>your new glasses? 
5.韩林通常走路去他的叔叔家。
Han Lin usually walks to <u>　　　　　　　　　　　　</u>. 
6.——你的爷爷有多少匹马?
——我看到(有)二十匹。
—<u>　　　　</u> <u>　　　　</u>horses does your grandfather have? 
—<u>　　　　</u> <u>　　　　</u>twenty. 
Ⅲ.单项填空
(　)1.—The cake tastes(尝起来) good.I want to have <u>　　　　</u>one. 
A.some	B.any
C.another	D.other
(　)2.—I don’t like this cap.It’s too big.
—Well,here is a<u>　　　　</u>one for you. 
A.small	B.short
C.long	D.tidy
(　)3.—Alan,can you <u>　　　　</u>from 1 to 100 in English? 
—Of course!One,two,three...
A.speak	B.tell
C.count	D.see
(　)4.—What animals can you find on the farm?
—I can find many <u>　　　　</u>and cows. 
A.rabbit	B.chicken
C.goose	D.sheep
(　)5.Which picture shows the dog is behind the house?
A.[IMG image42.jpeg]	B.[IMG image43.jpeg]
C.[IMG image44.jpeg]	D.[IMG image45.jpeg]
Ⅳ.根据短文内容或所给提示填空
My uncle is a farmer.He has ninety apple 1.[IMG image10.jpeg](tree) on his farm.My uncle and my 2.[IMG image10.jpeg](/aːnt/) can’t pick all the apples by themselves(他们自己).3.<u>　　　　</u>they ask my parents and me to help them today.We get up early 4.<u>　　　　</u> 5 o’clock in the morning.My mother is in her 5.<u>　　　　</u>(旧的) clothes.My father buys many 6.<u>　　　　</u>(kind) of food for breakfast in a shop.Then we start to pick apples together.When it is time to go home,my uncle 7.<u>　　　　</u>(give) us many apples.I like to work on the 8.<u>　　　　</u>(美丽的) farm. 
[IMG image4.jpeg]
Ⅰ.完形填空
Little Mary’s grandparents have a farm.On the farm there are many kinds of <u>　1　</u>,like dogs and cats.She likes to play with them because they can make her <u>　2　</u>.On the farm there <u>　3　</u> also a little elephant.It has no mother.It always walks around by itself.And Mary is really sorry for the death(死亡) of its <u>　4　</u>.Mary always gives some <u>　5　</u> to it.Bananas are its favourite.Sometimes Mary walks into a wood(树林) <u>　6　</u> the little elephant.There Mary sits on the ground(地面) and <u>　7　</u> a book;the little elephant stands by Mary.Her grandfather always asks her,“<u>　8　</u> does the elephant like you so much?” “Oh,because I love it,Grandpa,” Mary answers.Grandpa thinks Mary is <u>　9　</u>.Animals are our <u>　10　</u>.We should love them. 
(　)1.A.houses	B.trees
C.animals	D.colours
(　)2.A.sad	B.happy
C.sorry	D.tidy
(　)3.A.is	B.am
C.are	D.be
(　)4.A.friend	B.mother
C.teacher	D.brother
(　)5.A.time	B.names
C.food	D.boxes
(　)6.A.under	B.for
C.of	D.with
(　)7.A.reads	B.buys
C.sees	D.draws
(　)8.A.What	B.How
C.Why	D.When
(　)9.A.quiet	B.right
C.shy	D.old
(　)10.A.students	B.children
C.parents	D.friends
Ⅱ.阅读理解[IMG image46.jpeg]
Wu Zeyin,14,comes from Hubei,China.He finds that many fruits and vegetables(蔬菜) in Botswana are very small.And some of them are not good.The carrots are small and the tomatoes are green.But the price(价格) is very <u>high</u>.And he learns that Botswana has to buy many fruits and vegetables from other places.Wu wants to do something to help.
He made an app(应用程序) for agriculture(农业)—Farm Assistant.With the help of the app,farmers can know the vegetables’ planting time,watering needs and ripening(成熟) time.
Wu says,“<u>It is better to teach a man to fish than to give him fish.</u>” 
(　)1.What does the underlined word “high” mean?
A.实惠的	B.稳定的
C.高的	D.低的
(　)2.[**新考法**·**细节多选**]What can farmers know about the vegetables by using the app?
①The watering needs.②The selling price.③The planting time.④The ripening time.
A.①②③	B.①②④
C.①③④	D.②③④
(　)3.[**新考法**·**跨学科设问**]What do Wu’s words mean?
A.鱼和熊掌不可兼得。
B.授人以鱼,不如授人以渔。
C.三天打鱼,两天晒网。
D.临渊羡鱼,不如退而结网。
☆拓展设问
4.What does Wu find about the fruits and vegetables in Botswana?(不超过15个词)
<u> </u>

**参考答案**
[IMG image158.jpeg]基础巩固[IMG image159.jpeg]
Ⅰ.1.else　2.farm　3.circle　4.lake　5.big
Ⅱ.1.many kinds of　2.look at　3.black and white
4.What colour are　5.his uncle’s home　6.How many;I see
Ⅲ.1~5 CACDC
Ⅳ.1.trees　2.aunt　3.So　4.at　5.old　6.kinds
7.gives　8.beautiful
[IMG image158.jpeg]能力提升[IMG image159.jpeg]
Ⅰ.1~5 CBABC　6~10 DACBD
Ⅱ.1~3 CCB
☆拓展设问
4.Many of them are very small,and some of them are not good.
